title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Noodles
creator: Daniela's Dish
cookTime: Slow cooker: 2 hours on high or 4 hours on low, then 1 hour on high with frozen noodles (1/2 hour if using dry egg noodles)
ingredients: 24 oz Reames frozen egg noodles (or 12 oz dry egg noodles)
instructions: Step 1: Add the chicken to a slow cooker and season with salt, pepper, poultry seasoning and garlic powder.
Step 2: Spread the cream of chicken soup over top and dot with the butter.
Step 3: Mix the chicken broth with the bouillon and pour over top.
Step 4: Cover and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4 hours.
Step 5: Remove the chicken and add the noodles to the slow cooker. Cook on high for one hour, stirring occasionally (about 1/2 hour if using dry egg noodles).
Step 6: Shred the chicken, add it back to the slow cooker and combine.
notes: From a Daniela's Dish Facebook reel; recipe from the creator's 'Author' comment. Caption: a cozy, creamy vintage comfort dish similar to chicken and dumplings but with noodles, made easy in the slow cooker. Commenters say Reames frozen egg noodles are in the freezer section at Walmart, Kroger and other stores (often near the frozen pierogis), and Reames makes two bag sizes, so check you get the 24 oz one. Sara Johannsen Darling suggested using cream of chicken with herbs for more flavor; Jessica Baker would add carrots. Tyler Hagerdorn shared a simpler variation: 2 lbs chicken tenderloins, 2 cans chicken broth, 2 cans cream of chicken with herbs, 1 stick butter, cooked 4 hours high or 6 low, then shred chicken and add a 24 oz bag of frozen Reames noodles for another 45 minutes to an hour. Not stated: servings and prep time.
